name: hr-eval
description: Live, transparent one-session technical interview assessment. HR and candidate on a video call, candidate shares screen, generates task + profile + report all in front of HR. Logs every prompt, tool call, and edit during the interview, then produces a structured report against 7 signals of developer thinking (promptcraft, critical reception, verification, debugging methodology, architecture steering, environment & tooling, metacognition) with weighted scoring + recommendation tier applied inline. 4 commands: /eval-prepare (task + profile), /eval-start (consent + hooks + task), /eval-report (analyzer + scoring + handoff zip), /eval-stop (abort).
